SERVING SAN ANTONIO SINCE 1974

For more than 40 years, family owned and operated Air-Stream Air Conditioning and Heating Co. Inc. has been serving residential, commercial and government clients' HVAC needs. Our business is all about building relationships with our customers.

Owned by Richard and Rebecca Flores, Air-Stream is certified as a Minority and Woman-Owned Business and State of Texas HUB contractor. Richard Flores started Air-Stream in 1974 with one truck named “Tortilla.” In the years since then, the company has grown to be a premier provider of HVAC products and services in San Antonio and the surrounding areas. Uninterrupted service, reliability, and quick response are the key benefits provided by Air-Stream Air Conditioning and Heating Co. We take pride in our reputation for honesty, dependability, industry expertise and value.

At Air-Stream we believe that customer service is more than just a catchphrase. Unlike many HVAC companies, our employees do not work on commission. Therefore, they have no incentive to try to “upsell” you on products and services. Instead, our technicians have an incentive to provide the best solution for your particular needs and budget, as that is the philosophy that Richard Flores has instilled in his employees since the company’s inception. In addition, several of our top technicians have been with us for over 20 years and are highly experienced in both the commercial and residential side of the business. All of our trusted professionals have the authority to make crucial decisions on the spot. It is their responsibility to take decisive action in order to maintain uninterrupted service and improve reliability for you, our customer.
